# Mission: test Hither as a real new user

Read `AGENT_BRIEF.md` first and follow all of it: tools, rules, budget and the final
report format. This file only adds what is specific to Hither.

## The app
Hither helps a tour leader keep a travel group together: the leader creates a trip,
plans the itinerary and meeting points, and invites members; members join the trip
and follow the map, the itinerary and the distance to the next meeting point.
The main language is Traditional Chinese (zh-TW).

## Sign-in
- Use the guest / anonymous option when the app offers one.
- Never use Apple or Google sign-in: the Simulator has no account and the attempt
  is not a finding.
- Never enter a real e-mail or phone number.

## Permissions
- Allow location "While Using the App" when asked. The Simulator location is already
  set to the persona's city.
- Deny notifications unless the persona's goal needs them.

## Out of scope
- Do not buy anything. On a purchase or subscription screen, note what it shows and leave.
- Do not delete the account.

## Also check
- Text the persona cannot read: English left in a zh-TW screen, mixed simplified characters.
- The map and its controls at this text size: covered buttons, labels cut by the sheet.
